stations.label: Work order desk
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot allocates identities and reads interfaces; no autonomous physics

stations.label: Contained material storage
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot retrieves and returns verified lots

stations.label: Guarded wire preparation
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot positions/retains stock and handles tool controls; cutter owns guarded actuation

stations.label: Qualified shape preparation
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot mounts/retrieves and reads recipe; device owns qualified thermal program; no assumed recipe

stations.label: PMMA and PA12 fabrication
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot loads stock, requests qualified fabrication, removes/finishes/checks components; machine owns cutting or printing motion

stations.label: Packing and assembly
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot cleans, measures, packs, closes and inserts actual components

stations.label: Guarded thermal conditioning
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot loads/starts/reads/retrieves; device regulates heat and reports actual time/temperature

stations.label: Guarded tensile measurement
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot mounts and starts verified job; device moves crosshead and acquires force/displacement

stations.label: Supported cooling and recovery
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot parks and monitors; thermal process occurs under qualified method

stations.label: Calorimetry
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot prepares/loads/starts/reads/unloads; device owns thermal scan and sensing

stations.label: Single-rod bending
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot mounts/loads/unloads rod and sets observations; device supplies any controlled load/heat

stations.label: Guarded inclination measurement
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot prepares coupon, places test object and requests tilt; device controls tilt/heat and records signals

stations.label: Shielded tomography
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot loads/starts/reads/unloads only after interlock release; instrument owns ionizing-radiation scan

stations.label: Enclosed load demonstration
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot connects supported load and controls support withdrawal; fixture bears load, device maintains temperature

stations.label: Data workstation
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot submits recorded acquisitions; service computes derived records, never fabricated source outcomes

stations.label: Cleanup and disposition
stations.robot_device_boundary: Robot unloads, sorts, cleans, reconciles and records safe end states

transport_contract.applies_to: Every change of physical station, including consecutive route operations whose station differs
required: observed placement and unique current location
transport_contract.status: authored; no gait, grasp, torque, force or transport timing validated
